children: Beats, the headphones brand owned by Apple
, on Tuesday unveiled a new flagship over-ear model priced at $349.99.

The Beats 360 will be available in stores from Sept. 24 and can be ordered through Apple's website in more than 100 countries. The headphones include active noise cancellation and work with both Apple and Android devices.
Beats also cut the price of its Studio Pro headphones to $299.99 from $349.99.
Beats was founded by rapper Dr. Dre and legendary music producer Jimmy Iovine and bought by Apple in 2014.
introduced AirPods 5, which feature improved noise cancellation capabilities and a longer battery life. AirPods 5 sell for $129.

It also features a more natural Transparency mode, which allows the user to hear voices and sounds. The AirPods can automatically adjust between Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency. They have Live Translation as well, which Apple introduced last fall.
